scope: Primary-source follow-up for clean self_improvement candidates C3 and C4 after the main 68-candidate assessment.

causal_ablation: Single-Level freezes the slow loop while retaining fast task-skill evolution, so the +6.38/+8.05/+1.92 point differences isolate the marginal slow-loop contribution under the paper's setup.

Component ablations are primary-verified: OfficeQA full 55.32 falls to 35.58 without allocator alpha and 37.59 without proposal policy pi; SealQA full 45.26 falls to 36.84 without pi; ALFWorld full 94.23 falls to 86.54 without pi.
No cross-branch retrieval returns ALFWorld to 92.31, exactly the Single-Level result, bounding the source of the +1.92 point ALFWorld meta gain.
A held-out test partition is never observed by evolution; train/validation/test are disjoint and the paper includes validation-split sensitivity tests.
failure_scope: ALFWorld is near ceiling: static skill regresses by 1.93 points and fast single-level evolution adds zero over the raw backbone; only the slow loop adds +1.92 points.
Meta-update horizon sensitivity is task-dependent. With three meta-updates, OfficeQA drops 48.94 to 39.84 from H=2 to H=8, while SealQA/ALFWorld move much less.
The paper itself limits evidence to three curated benchmarks and does not establish transfer to open-ended long-horizon real-world tasks.
primary_verification.reproducibility: No author code repository was located from the primary paper during this pass. An independent public reimplementation exists and reproduces the method structure/toy mechanism, but it does not yet constitute a benchmark-level independent replication of the paper's headline numbers.

supersedes_assessments.judgment: Upgrade from C+ to A-. The previously unresolved marginal slow-loop numbers and component ablations are directly present in the primary paper. Evidence is strong for a scoped claim that meta-skill adaptation adds value beyond single-level skill evolution on these three held-out benchmarks, but preprint status, limited benchmark breadth, and lack of independent benchmark replication prevent a stronger replication claim.

supersedes_assessments.mechanism: Persistent curated external knowledge substrate with disposable agents (Knowledge-Centric Self-Improvement, KSI)

Haiku_4.5.Terminal-Bench_2: OURS 43.8%±3.4 vs Meta-Harness 37.6% and other Haiku-based systems lower

held_out_artifact_transfer: On 20 held-out hard Polyglot tasks, frozen donor knowledge improves every donor-recipient pairing over the corresponding no-knowledge recipient condition; e.g. GPT recipient 8.3%±2.9 no knowledge -> 20.0%±5.0 with GPT-authored knowledge and 11.7%±2.9 with Haiku-authored knowledge.

On 20 held-out hard ARC-AGI-1 tasks, GPT recipient 23.3%±2.9 no knowledge -> 43.3%±2.9 with GPT-authored knowledge and 38.3%±12.6 with Haiku-authored knowledge; Haiku recipient 13.3%±2.9 -> 28.3%±2.9 or 23.3%±2.9.

Recipient transfer runs use the frozen generation-10 artifact with no new forum or recipient-side distillation, providing a direct causal test that the external knowledge artifact itself carries useful transferable signal.
primary_verification.reproducibility: Author code repository is public. The paper documents benchmark adapters, information-parity gates, egress isolation, full-loop cost accounting, and baseline forks/adapters in detail.
primary_verification.remaining_causal_gap: The primary paper does not provide a clean component ablation that separately removes task-level forum, cross-task forum, and distillation while holding the rest fixed. Therefore evidence supports the full curated-knowledge protocol and the frozen knowledge artifact, not an isolated claim that each individual curation stage is necessary.

supersedes_assessments.judgment: Upgrade from B to A-. Exact primary tables, matched prompt-optimization budgets, cross-LLM results, held-out frozen-artifact transfer, and public code are all directly verified. The strongest causal claim is that a curated external knowledge artifact can improve unseen-task performance and transfer across model families. Component-level attribution among forum/distillation stages remains unresolved, and the baselines are not all repeated across seeds, so the candidate should remain scope-bounded.

retain_narrow_open_questions: MetaSkill-Evolve: obtain benchmark-level independent replication and matched token/dollar cost accounting for the recursive slow-loop marginal gain.
KSI: isolate task-forum, cross-task-forum, distillation, and task-conditioned adapter contributions with component ablations; seek independent reproduction of headline and held-out-transfer results.
